senses.gloss: (Buddhism) arhat (one who has attained enlightenment; a Buddhist saint)
(rare) a cutting tool consisting of two blades inserted into a long handle to cut grass or to harvest rice
small Buddhist temple, small pagoda; hermitage, secluded hut, cottage
(North Vietnam) a kind of water container; a kind of betel container
(archaic) species of Prunus; their fruits; cherry
